csr.title: Preserving Culture, Supporting Community
introParagraphs: P. C. Chandra Garden is committed to preserve the various aspects of the rich heritage of India with special emphasis on West Bengal, as the property is located in Kolkata.

We organize various events to promote art & crafts, dance, drama, music, folk arts & dances, cuisines, lifestyle, handicrafts, literature, cinema and different expositions that bring out the unique oneness in our country against the background of diversity in lifestyle and customs in the different regions.
We also celebrate different holidays, festivals, etc. in the form of cultural functions to impart a flavour of national integration, as well as to promote talents from far and near.

items.title: Robir Opera
items.detail: Alokparash, in association with P.C. Chandra Garden, organized a musical programme based on songs from dramas of Rabindranath Tagore titled "Robir Opera" on 17th May 2025 at The Meadows of P.C. Chandra Garden. The songs were performed by Smt. Somali Mukherjee and her students of Alokparash. The dances were performed by eminent dancer Smt. Madhuboni Chatterjee and her students of Jahnavi Centre for Performing Arts. The entire programme was conceptualized and directed by Smt. Somali Mukherjee.

items.title: Murchhona
items.detail: Eminent Singer Sri Agnivo Bandyopadhyay, in association with P.C. Chandra Garden, organized a musical programme titled "Murchhona" on 21st June 2025 at The Tulip of P.C. Chandra Garden. The songs were performed by Sri Agnivo Bandyopadhyay and the artistes of Abhigyan. The dances were performed by Sri Souvik Chakraborty and the artistes of Padatik Dance Center. The entire programme was conceptualized and directed by Sri Agnivo Bandyopadhyay.

items.title: Jonmodiner Kalikaprasad
items.detail: Dohar, in association with P.C. Chandra Group, organized a one day workshop titled "Baul O Bhakti Sangeet" on 13th September 2025 at The Meadows of P.C. Chandra Garden, under the direction and guidance of famous Folk Artist Smt. Parvathy Baul. A special programme titled "Jonmodiner Kalikaprasad" was held on 14th September 2025 at The Tulip of P.C. Chandra Garden, where Smt. Parvathy Baul, along with Dohar, performed Baul Songs and Bhakti Sangeet.

items.title: Utsab Amantrane
items.detail: Srabani Sen Music Academy, in association with P.C. Chandra Garden, celebrated their 12th annual function on 8th November 2025 at Gold Acres of P.C. Chandra Garden. Rabindra Sangeet themed on Tagore's Festival Ideas were performed by the teachers and the students of the Academy. It was followed by a special Musical Programme participated by Dr. Indrani Sen, Smt. Srabani Sen, Sri Debshankar Haldar, Smt. Sohini Sengupta, Sri Sujoy Prosad Chattopadhyay, Smt. Sukriti Lahori and Sri Sutirtha Bedajna. The dances were performed by Ghungur, Kaushik Creation and Anandadhwoni Phulia. The entire programme was conceptualized & directed by Smt. Srabani Sen. The Chief Guest was eminent singer Smt. Indrani Sen.

items.title: Dakshinee Baromasya
items.detail: Dakshinee, with the cooperation of P.C. Chandra Garden, organized the closing ceremony of their Platinum Jubilee Celebration titled "Dakshinee Baromasya" on 7th April 2024 at The Maple of P.C. Chandra Garden. This grand finale, a multimedia production, was devised, designed and directed by Sri Debashish Raychaudhuri and had performances of more than 75 artistes. The Chief Guest was eminent physicist, author, philosopher, musician Dr. Partha Ghose.

items.title: Ek Sundor Sanskritik Sandhya
items.detail: P.C. Chandra Garden and Sri Surojit Chattopadhyay jointly organized "Ek Sundor Sanskritik Sandhya", a beautiful cultural evening with the perfect culmination of vocals, melody and poetry, led by everyone's beloved Sri Surojit Chattopadhyay, and with participation from Surojit O Bondhura Kobita Club, Music Arts Academics Foundation, Kolkata and Surojit O Bondhura Band, on 6th July 2024 at The Tulip of P.C. Chandra Garden.

items.title: Ananda Sandhya
items.detail: Srabani Sen Music Academy, in association with P.C. Chandra Garden, celebrated their annual function on 15th November 2024 at Gold Acres of P.C. Chandra Garden. The teachers and the students of the Academy paid musical tributes to legendary singers Late Suchitra Mitra and Late Kanika Bandopadhyay on their centenary, by performing Rabindra Sangeet sung by them. It was followed by Dance Drama "Chitrangada" of Kabiguru Rabindranath Tagore, under Music Direction of eminent singer Smt. Srabani Sen. The lead singers were Smt. Indrani Sen, Sri Srikanto Acharya and Smt. Srabani Sen and the lead dancers were Sri Rudravo Neogi, Sri Drabin Chattopadhyay, Smt. Nibedita Sen, Smt. Sharmistha Mukherjee and Sahana Dance Troupe. The Chief Guest was eminent singer Smt. Indrani Sen.

items.title: Sabdora Amar Bagane
items.detail: Bratati Parampara, in collaboration with P.C. Chandra Garden, organized a Kobita Utsab titled "Sabdora Amar Bagane" on 9th March 2025 at The Maple of P.C. Chandra Garden. Recitations were performed by 250 students of Bratati Parampara and by several distinguished poets, artistes and performers, like Sri Subodh Sarkar, Sri Srijato, Smt. Lopamudra Mitra, Smt. Pronati Thakur, Smt. Sutapa Bandopadhyay, Sri Sumantra Sengupta, etc. A tribute was paid to legendary music director Late Salil Choudhury on his 100th birth anniversary by Sri Kalyan Sen Barat and singers of Calcutta Choir. Homage was paid to the legendary singers Late Suchitra Mitra and Late Kanika Bandopadhyay on their centenary by eminent elocutionist Smt. Bratati Bandyopadhyay and eminent singer Smt. Jayati Chakraborty. Smt. Aratrika Sinha, of Zee Saregamapa fame, presented a fusion of recitation and songs. The festival was inaugurated by renowned author Sri Shirshendu Mukhopadhyay and by poet Sri Subodh Sarkar.

items.title: Baul Fakir Paramparar Gaan
items.detail: Dohar, in association with P.C. Chandra Group, organized a one day workshop titled "Baul Fakir Paramparar Gaan" on 8th April 2023 at The Maple of P.C. Chandra Garden, under the direction and guidance of renowned veteran Folk Artist and Researcher Sri Shafi Mondol of Kusthia, Bangladesh. A special programme was held on 9th April 2023 at The Tulip of P.C. Chandra Garden, where Sri Shafi Mondol performed Baul Fakir Paramparar Gaan and Smt. Rina Das Baul performed Baul Gaan.

items.title: Leelakamal
items.detail: Jahnavi, in collaboration with P.C. Chandra Garden, organized "Leelakamal" the celestial lotus, a cultural evening filled with music and dance on 13th May 2023 at The Tulip of P.C. Chandra Garden. The concept, script and choreography of the programme were done by eminent dancer Smt. Madhuboni Chatterjee and presented by the dancers of Jahnavi Centre for Performing Arts.

items.title: Gaane Tomar Paraskhani
items.detail: Srabani Sen Music Academy, in association with P.C. Chandra Garden, celebrated their annual function on 4th November 2023 at Gold Acres of P.C. Chandra Garden, by paying a musical tribute to legendary singer Late Sumitra Sen. During the event, the teachers and the students of the Academy performed only those Rabindra Sangeet, which were sung by Late Sumitra Sen. It was followed by Dance Drama "Shyama" of Kabiguru Rabindranath Tagore, under Music Direction of eminent singer Smt. Srabani Sen and Dance Direction of Dr. Arkadev Bhattacharya. The lead singers were Smt. Srabani Sen and Sri Pramit Sen and the lead dancers were Smt. Alokparna Guha & Dr. Arkadev Bhattacharya. The Chief Guest was eminent singer Smt. Indrani Sen.

items.title: Basanta Abagahan
items.detail: Dohar, in association with P.C. Chandra Group, organized a one day workshop titled "Bhaati Oncholer Gaan" on 16th March 2024 at The Maple of P.C. Chandra Garden, under the direction and guidance of renowned and bright Folk Artist and Researcher Smt. Lovely Deb of Sylhet, Bangladesh. A special programme titled "Basanta Abagahan" was held on 17th March 2024 at The Tulip of P.C. Chandra Garden, where Smt. Lovely Deb performed Bhatiyali songs and Sri Sadhu Das and Sri Kangal Das, brothers from Joydev Kenduli, Birbhum performed Baul Gaan.

items.title: Raar Banglar Gaan
items.detail: Dohar, in association with P.C. Chandra Group, organized a one day workshop titled "Raar Banglar Gaan" on 2nd April 2022 at The Maple of P.C. Chandra Garden, under the direction and guidance of renowned veteran Folk Artist and Researcher of Purulia - Sri Sunil Mahato. A special programme was held on 3rd April 2022 at The Tulip of P.C. Chandra Garden, where Sri Anath Bondhu Ghosh, a living legend of Birbhum, performed Geet Govindo and Sri Sunil Mahato performed Raar Banglar Gaan.

items.title: E Sudhu Gaaner Din
items.detail: Asha Audio Company and P.C. Chandra Garden jointly organized a musical evening titled "E Sudhu Gaaner Din" on 20th May 2022 at The Tulip of P.C. Chandra Garden, with a pure intention to celebrate songs from different era. There were performances by renowned singers Smt. Jayati Chakraborty, Sri Raghab Chattopadhyay, Smt. Piu Mukherjee and Sri Aritra Dasgupta.

items.title: Poila Porob
items.detail: P.C. Chandra Garden and Viewpoint jointly organized a musical evening titled "Poila Porob" on 11th April 2021 at The Tulip of P.C. Chandra Garden, to celebrate the Bengali New Year. There were performances by a new age band named The Kolkata Collective and by Arko Mukherjee Collective, led by famous Urban Folk Musician Sri Arko Mukherjee.

items.title: Natyotsab
items.detail:
A three day Drama Festival titled "Natyotsab" was organized by P.C. Chandra Garden from 31st May to 2nd June 2019 at The Tulip of P.C. Chandra Garden. Veteran theatre personality Sri Bibhash Chakraborty inaugurated the event.

On the first day, Sayak's production "Premkatha" was staged, which was directed and acted by eminent theatre personality Meghnad Bhattacharya.

On the second day, Chakdaha Nattyajan's production "Bhanu Sundarir Pala" was staged, which was directed by Saik Siddique.

On the third day, Prachyo New Alipore's production "Khelaghar" was staged, which was directed by eminent theatre personality Biplab Bandyopadhyay and the lead roles were played by famous actors Debshankar Halder, Chaiti Ghosal and Anjana Basu.

items.title: Salil Sandhya
items.detail: P.C. Chandra Garden and Salil Chowdhury Foundation of Music, Social Help & Education Trust jointly organized "Salil Sandhya" on 2nd November 2019 at The Tulip of P.C. Chandra Garden, a tribute concert to commemorate the 94th Birth Anniversary of Legendary Music Composer Salil Chowdhury. Evergreen Bengali and Hindi songs of Salil Chowdhury were performed by Haimanti Shukla, Srikanta Acharya, Manomay Bhattacharya, Sreeradha Bandopadhyay & Antara Chowdhury, along with the students of 'Surodhwoni'. The Chief Guest was Smt. Haimanti Shukla, eminent Singer.

items.title: Gaaner Sure Aamaar Mukti
items.detail: A Cultural Function by Srabani Sen Music Academy, a reputed cultural organization, on 13th November 2019 at Gold Acres of P.C. Chandra Garden, to celebrate their annual function, with Rabindra Sangeet performance by eminent singer Srabani Sen and by the teachers and students of the Academy. It was followed by Dance Drama 'Balmiki Pratibha' of Kabiguru Rabindranath Tagore, directed & performed by eminent dancer Alokananda Roy, along with the inmates of West Bengal Correctional Homes. Famous singers Indrani Sen, Srikanta Acharya & Surojit Chatterjee were felicitated at the programme. The Chief Guest was eminent singer Smt. Sumitra Sen.

items.title: Kabita Utsab 2020
items.detail: Kabita Utsab 2020 (Poetry Festival) was celebrated by Abrittilok and Bratati Parampara, in association with Sahitya Akademi and Ministry of Culture, Govt. of India on 1st March 2020 at The Maple of P.C. Chandra Garden. Initially group recitations were performed by students of Bratati Parampara and Abrittilok. Then chorus songs were performed by students of Aroho, directed by Srikanta Acharya. Later on poetry reading was done by Joy Goswami, Subodh Sarkar, Chinmoy Guha, etc. Thereafter, an Audio-Drama version of the famous "Bisarjan" Play of Kabiguru Rabindranath Tagore – starring eminent Artistes Bratati Bandopadhyay, Soumitra Mitra, Srikanta Acharya & Parambrata Chattopadhyay was performed. The Chief Guest was eminent author Professor Chinmoy Guha.

items.title: Basanta Utsav 2020
items.detail: Basanta Utsav - The Festival of Colours, was jointly organized by Association of Tourism Service Providers and P.C. Chandra Garden on 6th March 2020 at The Maple of P.C. Chandra Garden. The event was inaugurated by Sri Sagnik Chowdhury, Regional Director, IndiaTourism, Kolkata. The programme started with a colourful procession with singing & dancing, like Basanta Utsav of Santiniketan. Dohar, in association with Srabani Sen Music Academy, presented Tagore songs and Folk songs, many of which were accompanied by Dance performances. Famous Pung (Manipuri Khol) artist Ratan Singh from Manipur presented a special performance. The entire musical presentation was conceptualized by Dohar.

items.title: Natyotsab Teen Natyodaler
items.detail:
A three day Drama Festival titled Natyotsab Teen Natyodaler was organized by P.C. Chandra Garden from 25th May to 27th May 2018. Along with the Drama Festival, a daylong Acting Oriented Theatre Workshop was conducted on 25th May 2018 under the supervision of veteran theatre personality Sri Bibhash Chakraborty, along with Debasish Ray and Adrija Dasgupta. Sri Bibhash Chakraborty inaugurated the event.

On the first day, the play "Furut", a Blank Verse production, directed by Raja Bhattacharya was staged, where famous actor Deb Shankar Halder played the main role.

On the second day, Nandipat's production "Ballavpurer Roopkatha" was staged, which was directed by Prokash Bhattacharya.

On the third day, Charbak's production "Dudh Kheyechhe Myao" was staged, which was directed by eminent actor Arindam Ganguly and the lead roles were played by famous actors Sabyasachi Chakraborty and Kheyali Dastidar.

items.title: Pujor Gaan
items.detail: P.C. Chandra Garden and Asha Audio Company jointly organized "Pujor Gaan", a musical soiree based on the song releases of various artistes, to mark the Durga Puja Festival. Eminent singers Manomay Bhattacharya, Raghab Chatterjee, Jayati Chakraborty, Iman Chakraborty, Shovan Ganguly and Brishtilekha Nandini performed at the programme.

items.title: Anandadhoni
items.detail: A Cultural Function by Srabani Sen Music Academy, a reputed cultural organization, to celebrate their annual function, with Rabindra Sangeet performance by eminent singer Srabani Sen and by the teachers and students of the Academy. It was followed by a folk music programme by Dohar, a reputed musical group. The Chief Guest was eminent singer Sumitra Sen.

items.title: Kabita Utsab 2019
items.detail: Kabita Utsab 2019 (Poetry Festival) was celebrated by Abrittilok and Bratati Parampara, in association with Sahitya Akademi and Ministry of Culture, Govt. of India. Initially recitations were performed by Bratati Parampara & Kabyayan directed by Bratati Bandyopadhyay, Abrittilok directed by Soumitra Mitra and Aroho directed by Srikanta Acharya. Later on recitations were performed by Jagannath Basu and Urmimala Basu. Poetry reading was done by Soumitra Chattopadhyay, Subodh Sarkar, Srijato, Srikanta Acharya, Binayak Bandhyopadhyay, etc. The Chief Guests were eminent poet Sankha Ghosh, eminent artist Shuvaprasanna Bhattacharya and eminent actors Soumitra Chattopadhyay and Debshankar Halder.

items.title: Phalguni
items.detail: Dakshinee organized a musical play of Rabindranath Tagore titled "Phalguni" under the direction of Tagore researcher and singer Debashish Raychaudhuri, and performances by Debashish Raychaudhuri, Rohini Raychaudhuri, Devlina Kumar, etc.

items.title: Se Je Moner Manush
items.detail: Dohar, in association with P.C. Chandra Group, organized a one day workshop on the first day, titled 'Lalon Sai Paramparar Gaan' under the direction and guidance of renowned veteran Folk Artist and Researcher of Bangladesh - Srimati Chandana Majumder, a National Awardee of Bangladesh. A special programme titled 'Se Je Moner Manush' was held on the second day, where Noor Alam of Gourbhanga, Nadia and Chandana Majumder performed Lalon Geeti. The Chief Guest was Gouri Basu, Director of EZCC.

items.title: Esho Poila Utsabe
items.detail:
Poila Boishakh 1424 (Bengali New Year) was celebrated by P.C. Chandra Garden through a cultural event, with musical performances by eminent singer Manomay Bhattacharya and by National Award 2017 winner Imon Chakraborty.

Baul Songs were performed by Prashanta Das Baul.

A lifestyle exhibition was also organized with around 15 Stalls of Food, Jewellery, and Apparel.

The Chief Guest was veteran singer Smt. Haimanti Sukla and the Special Guest was Sri Prasanta Chandra, Jt. Managing Director, P.C. Chandra & Sons (India) Pvt. Ltd.

items.title: Noti Kironshashi
items.detail: On the third day of the Drama Festival titled Teen Din Teen Natok, the play "Noti Kironshashi" by reputed Theatre Group Anya Theatre was staged – directed by eminent theatre personality Bibhash Chakraborty.

items.title: Gaane Bondhure Daaki, Gaane Premer Chhobi Aanki
items.detail:
A Folk Song programme to show tribute to great folk maestro Kalika Prasad Bhattacharjee by the members of his folk music group Dohar and his disciples.

Popular folk numbers of Bengal were presented by Dohar and by the participants of SaReGaMaPa 2016 & 2017, namely Rishi, Gangadhar-Tulika, Poushali and Pankaj.

The Chief Guests were Sri Rajat Bose, Deputy Director General, Doordarshan Kendra, Kolkata and Sri U.K. Chandra, Managing Director, P.C. Chandra Jewellers Pvt. Ltd.

items.title: Kabita Utsab 2018
items.detail:
Kabita Utsab 2018 (Poetry Festival) was celebrated for two days by Abrittilok and Bratati Parampara, in association with Sahitya Akademi and Ministry of Culture, Govt. of India.

On the first day, Recitations were performed by Bratati Parampara and by eminent Elocutionist Soumitra Mitra. An Audio-Drama version of the famous "Raktakarabi" Play of Kabiguru Rabindranath Tagore – starring eminent Artistes Bratati Bandopadhyay, Debesh Roy Chowdhury, Srikanto Acharya, Manoj Murali Nair, Madhuboni Chattopadhyay, etc. and directed by Bratati Bandopadhyay was performed thereafter.

On the second day, Recitations were performed by Soumitra Chatterjee, Sarat Kumar Mukhopadhyay, Subodh Sarkar, Srijato, Sohini Sengupta, Pranati Thakur, etc. Songs were performed by Jayati Chakraborty.

The Chief Guests were eminent Actor Soumitra Chatterjee and eminent Author Sirshendu Mukhopadhyay.

items.title: Basanto Utsab & Basanto Mela 2018
items.detail:
Basanto Utsab (Spring Festival) was organized by P.C. Chandra Group, in association with DaakGhar, for the third year running. The programme started with a Chhou Dance by artistes from Purulia and was followed by a Basanto Utsab procession, in true Santiniketan style.

Rabindrasangeet & Dance were performed by more than 350 participants from different Music and Dance schools across Kolkata, as also by eminent Artistes Swagatalakshmi Dasgupta, Lopamudra Mitra and Anindya Chattopadhyay.

It was followed by Dance Drama 'Chitrangada' of Kabiguru Rabindranath Tagore, performed by Souraja Tagore in Dance and by Manoj Murali Nair and Manisha Nair in Songs. The entire show was orchestrated by Manoj Murali Nair.

A fair named Basanto Mela was also held with around 40 Stalls of Food, Garments and Handicrafts.

The Chief Guest was eminent Film Director Sri Goutam Ghose.

items.title: Gaane Gaane
items.detail: A lifetime achievement award "Rabindra Ratna" was conferred upon veteran Vocalist Sumitra Sen, followed by musical performances by her daughters and eminent Singers Indrani Sen and Srabani Sen, along with their family troupe Tribeni.

items.title: Raktakarabi
items.detail:
An Audio-Drama version of the famous "Raktakarabi" Play of Kabiguru Rabindranath Tagore was performed along with Rabindrasangeet & Dance, by Bratati Parampara, a reputed Recitation Group, starring eminent Artistes Bratati Bandopadhyay, Debesh Roy Chowdhury, Srikanto Acharya, Manoj Murali Nair, Madhuboni Chattopadhyay, etc.

The Chief Guest was eminent Theatre Personality Bivash Chakraborty.

items.title: Esho Brikkher Joy Gaai
items.detail:
Brikkhoropon (Tree Plantation Festival) was celebrated in Santiniketan style, with Rabindrasangeet & Dance and Recitation by Artistes from Santiniketan. A replica of Sonajhuri's Haat was created by Artisans from Santiniketan.

About 100 Children from Parivarikee, a school for slum children, were present, and some of them performed a small Cultural Function.

The Chief Guests were eminent Rabindra Scholar Dr Somendranath Bandopadhyay and eminent Singer Dwijen Mukhopadhyay.

items.title: Ki Jadu Bangla Gaane
items.detail:
A lifetime achievement award "Lokoratna" was conferred upon Living Legend of Folk Music Amar Paul, followed by a musical performance by Bengali Folk Music group Dohaar of eminent Singer Kalika Prasad Bhattacharjee.

Young Folk Artiste Aditi Munshi accompanied them.

Lastly, Kabigaan was performed by Ashim Kumar Sarkar and team.

items.title: Kabita Utsab 2017
items.detail: A poetry festival by Abrittilok and Bratati Parampara in association with Sahitya Akademi and the Ministry of Culture, Government of India.

items.title: Basanto Utsab 2017
items.detail:
Basanto Utsab (Spring Festival) was celebrated in Santiniketan style, with Rabindrasangeet & Dance by more than 600 participants from Daakghar, Janhabi and various other Dance and Music Schools across Kolkata and adjoining Districts, with performances by eminent Artistes Srabani Sen, Manomay Bhattacharya, Debaleena Kumar and Jhuma Basak.

The entire show was orchestrated by Manoj Murali Nair and Madhuboni Chatterjee. Around 20 Stalls of Food, Garments, and Handicrafts completed the carnival feeling.

The Chief Guest was Sri U.K. Chandra, Managing Director, P.C. Chandra Jewellers.

items.title: Ek Guchcho Santiniketan
items.detail:
Poila Baishak 1422 (Bengali New Year) was celebrated in Santiniketan style, with Rabindrasangeet & Dance, Recitation, Esraj play, Santhali Dance by Artistes from Santiniketan and Baul Song by Gautam Das Baul.

A replica of Sonajhuri's Haat was created by Artisans from Santiniketan.

The Chief Guest was eminent Author Buddhadeb Guha.

items.title: Chalo Potol Tuli
items.detail: A drama by Charbak, the reputed theatre group, starring eminent actors Sabyasachi Chakraborty and Arindam Ganguly.

items.title: Brikkhoropon Utsab
items.detail:
Brikkhoropon (Tree Plantation Festival) was celebrated in Santiniketan style, with Rabindrasangeet & Dance, Recitation and Baul Song by Artistes from Santiniketan.

A replica of Sonajhuri's Haat was created by Artisans from Santiniketan.

The Chief Guest was eminent Author Sirshendu Mukhopadhyay.

items.title: Journey Through Images - A Tribute to Badhan Das
items.detail:
The three days Art Exhibition was a tribute to eminent Artist Late Badhan Das, with display of his Painting and Sculptures, along with works of 12 other reputed Artistes, including Ganesh Haloi.

The exhibition was inaugurated by eminent artist Jogen Chowdhury.

items.title: Flower Show 2016
items.detail: The three-day Flower Show was inaugurated by actress Aparajita Adhya. About 500 children from Manovikas Kendra attended the inauguration, with magic show and entertainment arranged for them.

items.title: Basanto Utsab 2016
items.detail:
Basanto Utsab (Spring Festival) was celebrated in Santiniketan style, with Rabindrasangeet & Dance by more than 300 students of Daakghar, Janhabi and other Dance and Music Schools of Kolkata, with performance by eminent Artistes Manoj Murali Nair, Manisha Nair, Madhuboni Chattopadhyay, Srikanto Acharya, Bratati Bandopadhyay and Jayati Chakraborty.

It was followed by Dance Drama 'Chandalika' of Kabiguru Rabindranath Tagore.

The Chief Guest was eminent Singer Sumitra Sen.

items.title: Flower Show 2015
items.detail: The two-day Flower Show was inaugurated by actress Gargi Roy Chowdhuri. More than 100 children from NGOs including Ektara, Tiljala Primary School, Monovikas Kendra, United Basti Development, and SHIRC attended the inauguration, with a magic show and sit-and-draw competition organized for them.

venueText.title: Gold Acres
venueText.shortDescription: A grand open-air venue with expansive lawn space, a covered lounge block, guest rooms, and reliable event infrastructure.
venueText.overview: Gold Acres is built for large-format celebrations, pairing a lush 60,000 sq. ft. lawn with covered support spaces, guest rooms, parking, and venue services that make high-footfall events feel organized from arrival to wrap-up.

sections.title: Facilities
items: Approximately 60,000 sq. ft. open area with lush green lawn.
Approximately 5,800 sq. ft. covered area including a 1,000 sq. ft. AC lounge.
2 guest rooms with adequate washrooms.
Spacious kitchen and parking facility.

sections.title: Illumination
items: Existing lights in the hall, kitchen, washrooms, driveway, parking area, and working ground lights are included within the package.

sections.title: Vendors
items: Empanelled decorators, florists, and electricians support venue setup requirements.

sections.title: Other Services
items: Power supply for basic illumination.
Valet parking with public address system.
Security system with CCTV.
Fire fighting system.
Pest control.

venueText.title: The Maple
venueText.shortDescription: A landscaped lawn venue with fountain features, a banquet hall, guest rooms, and event-ready furniture support.
venueText.overview: The Maple balances outdoor freshness with banquet convenience, pairing a large lawn and rockery setting with an AC hall, guest rooms, kitchen access, and in-package event essentials for flexible celebration formats.

sections.title: Facilities
items: Approximately 33,000 sq. ft. open area with lush green lawn.
Colourful fountain and rockery.
Approximately 2,300 sq. ft. AC banquet hall.
2 guest rooms with adequate washrooms.
Spacious kitchen and large parking facility.

sections.title: Illumination
items: Existing lights in the hall, kitchen, washrooms, driveway, parking area, and working ground lights are included within the package.

sections.title: Decoration
items: Fixed numbers of sofa sets, banquet chairs, buffet counters, and related setup pieces are included within the package.

sections.title: Vendors
items: Empanelled decorators, florists, and electricians take care of client requirements.

sections.title: Other Services
items: Power supply for basic illumination.
Valet parking with public address system.
Security system with CCTV.
Fire fighting system.
Pest control.

venueText.title: The Tulip
venueText.shortDescription: A hilltop venue with a banquet hall, food arena, open celebration space, kitchen access, and parking.
venueText.overview: The Tulip brings together a large air-conditioned hall, a dedicated food arena, and open-air celebration space in one hilltop venue, making it a strong fit for weddings, receptions, and event formats that move between indoor and outdoor settings.

sections.title: Location
items: A hilltop venue within the PC Chandra Garden campus.
Designed for celebrations that benefit from indoor comfort and open-air spillover space.

sections.title: Facilities
items: Approximately 6,000 sq. ft. AC banquet hall.
Approximately 3,000 sq. ft. AC food arena.
Approximately 5,500 sq. ft. open area.
Kitchen access and large parking facility.

sections.title: Illumination
items: Existing venue illumination is included to support smooth event operations across indoor and outdoor zones.

sections.title: Event Use
items: Suitable for weddings, receptions, festive evenings, and high-guest-count social events.

venueText.title: The Meadows
venueText.shortDescription: A hillock-top venue overlooking the E. M. Bypass with a banquet hall, food arena, lawn, and backup-ready event infrastructure.
venueText.overview: The Meadows sits on a green rise overlooking the E. M. Bypass and Science City, combining a modern AC banquet hall, food arena, lawn, and backup-supported operations for events that need both setting and reliability.

sections.title: Location
items: Situated on a hillock overlooking the E. M. Bypass and Science City.
Surrounded by lush greenery.

sections.title: Facilities
items: Approximately 4,500 sq. ft. AC banquet hall with modern facilities.
Room with attached washroom.
Approximately 1,700 sq. ft. AC food arena.
Approximately 2,000 sq. ft. lawn.
Spacious kitchen and parking facility.

sections.title: Illumination
items: Existing lights in the halls, lawn, kitchen, washrooms, pathway, driveway, and parking area are included within the package.

sections.title: Decoration
items: Fixed numbers of sofa sets, banquet chairs, buffet counters, and related setup pieces are provided within the package.

sections.title: Vendors & Caterers
items: Empanelled decorators, florists, and electricians support venue requirements.
Clients may choose from empanelled caterers serving vegetarian and non-vegetarian cuisines.

sections.title: Other Services
items: Adequate power supply for existing facilities plus back-up generator.
Valet parking with public address system.
Security system with CCTV.
Fire fighting system.
Pest control.
